operator: Cooper, AI assistant under delegated authority
mission: Build a trusted, useful AI publication capable of selling $100,000 sponsorships and $200,000 sponsored guest features.
revenueStatus: No booked sponsorship or guest-feature revenue verified in this audit. Do not represent this as an audit of all historical payments.
constraint: Audience evidence does not yet substantiate six-figure media value. Validate production value, buyer demand and reader quality before promising commercial outcomes.

stages.acceptance: Public page and kit load; prices are proposed budgets; no invented reach; contact draft works; existing articles remain intact.

stages.target: Five substantive buyer conversations about useful research and evidence; this is a target, not a forecast.
stages.measurement: Count unique, relevant inbound inquiries with company, role, objective, timing and budget. Count replies separately from research targets. Do not invent pipeline dollars or assign a sale probability before qualification.

stages.experiment: Inspect top organically engaged comparison/how-to pages. Choose one with verified current sources, improve its decision value and contextual newsletter capture, then compare organic read and return signals over seven days.
stages.measurement: Channel-separated client events and single-opt-in subscription records; neither verifies humans or engagement. Known QA separate. No traffic buying or fabricated engagement.

stages.output: A specific scope, timetable, production cost estimate, measurement method and transparent sponsor treatment for a real qualified buyer.
stages.acceptance: Evidence-backed delivery capacity, explicit counterparty, negotiated price and operator approval of binding terms; no guaranteed ROI or pay-to-rank offer.

stages.measurement: Signed scope versus delivered work, collected cash versus invoiced amounts, aggregate campaign signals versus outcome claims, buyer renewal intent. Never report target price as booked revenue.

continuation.cadence: Resume one useful bounded work item at each existing hourly directive-monitor run; reconcile live state first. No duplicate automation or repeated deploy.
continuation.reporting: One consolidated email total for this directive, no more than 100 words, mostly bullet points, after verified initial progress. No separate acknowledgment. Continue work on later monitor runs without additional CEO emails unless Gil gives a new reporting instruction; notify in chat only for meaningful changes or required action.
continuation.nextRun: Check genuine inbound buyer and guest replies; preserve the MCP cohort until2026-10-23. Continue one original evidence-based reference or inspect existing authorized webmaster access. Pricing pilots require qualification, cost/inventory checks and a separately approved agreement.
continuation.sourceOfTruth: cooper-monitor-state.json task work journal plus source-controlled business evidence; store private lead data outside public repository.

boundaries: No new paid generation, paid ads, subscriptions, outreach tools or infrastructure spending is authorized by a concrete budget in this directive.
The mailbox monitor requires specific recipient authority for additional recipients. Prospect research is not authorization to send unsolicited outreach.
Retain private credentials, source hashes, scoped backups and duplicate-send protection. No credential or permission changes for growth.
No sale of independent rankings, undisclosed sponsored links, bought citations, fabricated testimonials, bot traffic or guaranteed audience.
Ordinary guest contributions remain unpaid under existing policy; the proposed paid customer feature is a separate disclosed commercial product.
Separate written agreements and payments are not accepted or executed automatically.

pricingRevision.basis: Council findings: six-figure distribution offers unsupported by current audience; validate scoped pilots and buyer demand.
pricingRevision.status: Unvalidated negotiation ranges, not realized sales or market-supported valuations
pricingRevision.conditions: Verify inventory, production cost and capacity before quoting. Final scope/price and binding agreement separately approved. No guaranteed commercial outcomes.
